meta.name: The Farms
meta.blurb: A failing harvest and the roads the warband will come down.

activities.name: Work the failing fields
activities.blurb: The barley came up blighted and thin. Whatever can still be cut is cut, and a hungry town counts every sheaf.

activities.name: Stand at the reeve's ledger
activities.blurb: The manor reeve guards the granary with his great book and a tally of who has eaten and who has not.

activities.name: Watch the outer roads
activities.blurb: Beyond the last field the lanes run empty toward the burning country. Whatever comes for St Sebastian comes by these roads first.

activities.name: Sit with the farmhands
activities.blurb: In the cattle byre the cottars share what little there is and say aloud what the town will not. Hungry men, and angry ones.
